create_SemanticToolFilterHook: create a SemanticToolFilterHook instance to filter MCP tools semantically before LLM inference
run_async_pre_call_hook: run the async_pre_call_hook to filter tools based on semantic similarity to the user query
initialize_from_config: initialize the SemanticToolFilterHook from a proxy configuration dict with embedding model and top_k settings
expand_mcp_tools: expand MCP tool references to actual tool definitions using the LiteLLM proxy MCP handler
add_filter_stats_to_headers: add semantic filter statistics and filtered tool names to LLM response headers
